An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", new ConversionOptions { DataAsElements = new List<string>() {  } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
